title: House doc generator
description: Write the generated house docs — HOUSE.rules.md (always-on directives, imported by CLAUDE.md) and HOUSE.md (mechanical how-to, carrying the toolkit version stamp in its header) — and keep the bounded pointer to them in CLAUDE.md, seeding that file if the repo has none. Generator-owned: both docs are rewritten every run; in an existing CLAUDE.md only the marker-delimited pointer block is touched.

firebase.description: Render the Firebase sections of HOUSE.md. Defaults to auto-detect (firebase.json at the workspace root).

layers.description: The layers this project has (nx, agent, js, web, angular, design-system, navigation, firebase). Chooses which HOUSE.md sections render — a plain TypeScript repo gets no Angular MCP or design-system instructions — and is recorded in the header stamp so a later session can see that the project has since GROWN a layer whose house tooling was never applied. Defaults to DETECTING them from the workspace; scaffold.sh passes them explicitly because it knows what it just ensured, before the tree reflects it.

nxToolsVersion.description: The @bespunky/nx-tools version these generators come from, stamped into HOUSE.md's header. This is the version the SessionStart hook compares — it determines what the generators produce. Passed by scaffold.sh; defaults to 'unknown' on a direct generator call.

pluginVersion.description: The bespunky-project-starter plugin version that shipped these generators, stamped into HOUSE.md's header for provenance. Deliberately NOT what the hook compares (the house convention bumps it on any change, including ones that regenerate nothing). Passed by scaffold.sh; defaults to 'unknown' on a direct generator call.

packageManager.description: The package manager this project uses. Substituted into every command block in HOUSE.md, so the doc the agent reads and copies from matches the project. Passed by scaffold.sh (which detects it from the lockfile); defaults to detecting it here.
